verdict.rationale: Sentry documents a free, self-hosted 'minimal setup that works out-of-the-box' that runs all of Sentry on your own server, and one user reports running it reliably for years. However, the docs say it carries no guarantees or dedicated support. Community reports, including the founder admitting it is 'awful today to self-host' and users seeing it eat a 32GB server, show it is heavy for a quick local or dev instance. missing for 10: a lightweight documented local/dev-mode instance, documented resource requirements, and evidence of testing instrumentation and dashboards against a local instance.
